# Village of Alburgh municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 1; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Village of Alburgh official website, home page (read October 17, 2026), 'Village Trustees': Robert Savage; Herbert Durham, Chairman; Heath Bovat; Walter Kane; Aidan Poquette. The same page carries an August 5, 2026 notice of a Board of Trustees vacancy while listing five trustees; the roster is recorded as printed.

Village of Alburgh charter, 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 203, section 301(a)-(b): one trustee is elected at each annual meeting to a five-year term (five staggered seats); section 303 authorizes the trustees to fill vacancies by appointment.
Village of Alburgh official website, home page (read October 17, 2026): 'Village Clerk / Treasurer' Cheryl Dunn.
Village of Alburgh charter, 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 203, section 301(c): the Board of Trustees appoints the Village Clerk and the Village Treasurer.
Village of Alburgh official website, home page (read October 17, 2026): 'Village Clerk / Treasurer' Cheryl Dunn.
Village of Alburgh charter, 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 203, section 301(c): the Board of Trustees appoints the Village Clerk and the Village Treasurer.

Office established by the Village of Alburgh charter, 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 203, section 301(a)(2) (one Collector elected at each annual meeting, one-year term). No official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the current holder; the post is created as structure only.

Office established by the Village of Alburgh charter, 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 203, section 301(a)(3) (one auditor elected at each annual meeting to a three-year term; three staggered seats). No official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the current holders; the post is created as structure only.
